articles.title: Philadelphia science museum closes as supporters seek a way back
articles.summary: Philadelphia's Academy of Natural Sciences Museum has closed to visitors. A foundation offered a year of funding, but reopening would require a longer-term plan.

articles.title: Judge temporarily stops border construction in Texas' Big Bend region
articles.summary: A federal judge has temporarily blocked border construction across Texas' Big Bend region. The ruling includes the national park and comes during a legal challenge over protective rules.

articles.title: US hiring slows as families face rising prices
articles.summary: US employers added 29,000 jobs in September, and unemployment rose slightly. A Federal Reserve official says price increases remain a concern even as unemployment stays relatively low.
